changes: Aurora's x86_64 Mesa (aurora-silicon/mesa 9a21c0c6220, the same commit as the host mesa) as the FEX guest graphics layer, laid out for Debian and Ubuntu root filesystems, and aurora-fex-mesa.service, which lays it over FEX's stock guest root filesystem.
notes: The one package with non-arm64 code: x86_64 Mesa in /usr/share/guestos, Architecture all. It must be built on an amd64 build machine (build-package --cross on amd64); a native arm64 build stops with that message. No i686 half yet: see docs/parity/graphics.md.
